keyEvents.text: Goal! Birmingham City 1, Millwall 0. Alex Cochrane (Birmingham City) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner following a set piece situation.
Goal! Birmingham City 2, Millwall 0. Max Bird (Birmingham City) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jhon Solís with a headed pass.
Goal! Birmingham City 3, Millwall 0. Jay Stansfield (Birmingham City) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Max Bird following a fast break.
First Half ends, Birmingham City 3, Millwall 0.
Substitution, Millwall. Mark Sykes replaces Mihailo Ivanovic.
Substitution, Millwall. Daniel Kelly replaces Zak Sturge.
Jordi Osei-Tutu (Millwall) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Alex Cochrane (Birmingham City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Millwall. Josh Coburn replaces Lyndon Dykes.
Substitution, Millwall. Romain Esse replaces Kyrell Lisbie.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Demarai Gray replaces Liam Millar.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Bright Osayi-Samuel replaces Ethan Laird.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Carlos Vicente replaces Patrick Roberts.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Taylor Gardner-Hickman replaces Max Bird.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Luis Vázquez replaces Jay Stansfield.
Substitution, Millwall. Yanis Issoufou replaces Derek Mazou-Sacko.
Second Half ends, Birmingham City 3, Millwall 0.
